mapper.sql: pa.alert_id AS alertId, pa.watchlist_id AS watchlistId, pa.symbol, i.name AS instrumentName, pa.direction, pa.threshold, pa.status, pa.created_at AS createdAt, pa.triggered_at AS triggeredAt, pa.trigger_price AS triggerPrice, COALESCE(wq.last_price, mqs.last_price) AS lastPrice, i.currency FROM price_alerts pa INNER JOIN watchlists w ON w.watchlist_id = pa.watchlist_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = w.instrument_id LEFT JOIN watchlist_quotes wq ON wq.symbol = pa.symbol LEFT JOIN market_quote_snapshots mqs ON mqs.symbol = pa.symbol
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('price_alerts:' || CAST(#{accountId} AS TEXT)))) AS locked
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_alerts ( account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, delivery_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{watchlistId}, #{symbol}, #{direction}, #{threshold}, #{status}, #{deliveryId, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT alert_id, account_id, watchlist_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, delivery_id, created_at, triggered_at, trigger_price FROM price_alerts WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND threshold BETWEEN #{low} AND #{high} ORDER BY alert_id
